description: This is a source file for the LogView class in an Android application. It defines a custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting log messages and displaying them within the view.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView used to display log messages received via the LogNode interface. It formats log messages, handles UI thread updates, and supports chaining with other LogNodes.
